gate: Metric-Affine Pillar-3 Branch / Einstein-Sector Projection Minimality Gate

metric_affine_decomposition.convention: Q_{mu nu rho}=-nabla_mu g_{nu rho}; T^lam_{mu nu}=Gamma^lam_{mu nu}-Gamma^lam_{nu mu}
metric_affine_decomposition.contortion: K^lam_{mu nu}=1/2 g^{lam rho}(T_{rho mu nu}-T_{mu nu rho}-T_{nu mu rho})
metric_affine_decomposition.disformation: L^lam_{mu nu}=1/2 g^{lam rho}(-Q_{rho mu nu}+Q_{mu rho nu}+Q_{nu rho mu})
metric_affine_decomposition.theorem: For a given nondegenerate metric and affine connection the decomposition is unique under the stated convention.

Q_zero_T_nonzero.meaning: metric compatibility alone leaves contorsion and does not recover Levi-Civita

T_zero_Q_nonzero.meaning: torsion freedom alone leaves disformation and does not recover Levi-Civita

Q_zero_T_zero.meaning: both conditions together force Gamma=Gamma_LC for the supplied metric

levi_civita_sector_can_be_curved.meaning: Q=T=0 selects Levi-Civita connection, not flat connection or vacuum Einstein equations.

retained_sector_nonempty_control.global_state: three-qubit positive state with only weak full-rank pair Pauli correlations and maximally mixed one-body marginals
retained_sector_nonempty_control.meaning: A retained discrete sector can have exact local BKM metric compatibility and zero torsion-like solder closure while retaining nonzero polar holonomy.

sector_restriction.definition: restrict admissible configurations to those already satisfying Q=0 and T=0
sector_restriction.effect: does not mathematically require curvature/holonomy to vanish; nontrivial retained-holonomy examples exist

generic_projection.definition: replace a generic retained connection by a metric-compatible/Levi-Civita representative
generic_projection.meaning: projection is mathematically possible and idempotent, but it changes gauge-invariant connection observables; it is not a gauge transformation or a derived equivalence relation.

restriction_vs_projection.provenance_boundary: W1/W2 history identities need not be deleted by the projection, but any provenance observable that depends on retained transport/holonomy can change. Therefore projection cannot be treated as provenance-preserving without a separate theorem.

retained_data_supply_map.curvature: section-independent local holonomy curvature 2-form closed conditionally on the frozen continuum stack

Pillar3_reframing.parent_kinematics: metric-affine is the honest general container for the currently separated metric and retained-connection channels
Pillar3_reframing.ADM_Einstein_boundary: Q=T=0 is only the geometric prerequisite for the Path-A Levi-Civita/Ricci/ADM correspondence; it does not itself derive Einstein equations or stress-energy
Pillar3_reframing.projection_history: earlier Retained Bridge projection searches found no non-tuned metric-compatible macroscopic projection that preserved nontrivial geometry and beat nulls
Pillar3_reframing.new_question: not whether generic retained geometry equals GR, but whether a Q=T=0 retained sector is selected and closed under admissible retained operations/refinement/source structure
